blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines— The Department of Transportation (DOTr) on Wednesday, formally installed its new heads of three attached agencies, with Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon outlining their priorities as part of the department’s push for faster reforms. Dizon introduced the new chiefs of the Land Transportation Office (LTO), Maritime Industry Authority (Marina), and Philippine National Railways (PNR) during a press conference before they took their oaths of office. Former LTO chief Markus Lacanilao has been appointed Marina administrator, with Dizon directing him to modernize the agency and improve the welfare of Filipino seafarers. “Our seafarers are very important.
